name: Freesurfer 7.1.1 Longitudinal (Step1/2)
summary: Builds a FreeSurfer 7.1.1 longitudinal base (within-subject template) from several cross-sectional FreeSurfer outputs of the same subject with recon-all -base; step 1 of 2 of longitudinal processing.
description: Runs recon-all -base -all over all input FreeSurfer outputs (timepoints named by the md5 of their norm.mgz) to create an unbiased within-subject template. Use it before Step 2/2, which runs recon-all -long for each timepoint against this template. All inputs must be cross-sectional FreeSurfer runs of the same subject; requires a FreeSurfer license and can take many hours. See https://surfer.nmr.mgh.harvard.edu/fswiki/FsTutorial/LongitudinalTutorial

inputs.description: Cross-sectional FreeSurfer recon-all outputs of the same subject at different timepoints.
inputs.requirements: At least two timepoints of the same subject, each with mri/norm.mgz.

outputs.description: Longitudinal template: the recon-all base subject directory (template/) plus the mri folders of each timepoint (timepoints/<id>/), as needed by Step 2/2.

parameters.description: Fixed to base: makes main run base.sh (recon-all -base). Do not change.
